raw_specs.label: Совместимость
raw_specs.value: For use with XBOX systems and PCs running Windows 7 or later. Windows 10/11: requires Bluetooth, included USB cable, or XBOX Wireless adapter (sold separately). Windows 7 or 8.1: requires included USB cable; some functionality not supported.

raw_specs.label: Совместимость с Xbox Accessories
raw_specs.value: Available on XBOX consoles and Windows 10/11.

raw_specs.label: Аудиоразъём
raw_specs.value: Includes 3.5mm stereo headset jack. Also compatible with the XBOX One Stereo Headset Adapter and all other XBOX controller accessories made by Microsoft.

raw_specs.label: Тактильная отдача
raw_specs.value: Features Impulse Triggers and rumble motors. Motor control can be adjusted in the app.

raw_specs.label: Подключение
raw_specs.value: Connect to XBOX consoles with XBOX Wireless, or using the included 9’ USB-C cable. Wirelessly connect to Window PCs, tablets, Android, and iOS devices using Bluetooth, or with the included 9’ USB-C cable. Connect to Windows 7 or 8.1 PCs with the included 9’ USB-C cable; some functionality not supported.

raw_specs.label: Аккумулятор и время работы
raw_specs.value: Internal, rechargeable battery with up to 40 hours of battery life per charge. Battery life varies with usage and other factors.

raw_specs.label: Назначаемые кнопки
raw_specs.value: A, B, X, and Y; D-pad up, down, left, and right; Left and right bumpers; Left and right triggers; Left and right thumbstick click; 4 paddles.
